entries.name: Caterpillar
entries.style: chibi cube pet, deliberately blocky (Kenney Cube Pets): one round, cube-like segment with four stubby feet, two knobbed antennae, white mandibles and a raised band across the back; coloured as a yellow caterpillar with a red back band (the cel scripts have no green); stylized size: 0.3 m to the top of the antennae, half the cube-pet monkey (0.6 m) and about knee-high on it, so in a garden two-shot the face and antennae still read while it stays clearly the small creature (a real caterpillar is about 5 cm, which would be a speck beside the monkey); rigid parts moved by node tracks, no skin; colour map flattened to flat colours

source.author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
source.note: The plan's own source (wave-1 row 57). Same zip, pin and route as the panda and monkey: ingested through Blender, with Textures/colormap.png as an extra member; the colour map flattens to 24 clusters: the 15 green clusters (a baked gradient on the body, legs and antennae) -> body, the 7 yellow clusters of the raised band across the back -> stripe, #e4e4ee -> eye (eye whites and mandibles), #4b4e5c -> dark (pupils, mouth). Recoloured from Kenney's green caterpillar with a yellow back band to a yellow caterpillar with a red band on the indigo script, which has no green. Ground: run hops and clamps so its landings never sink; walk is a bouncy trot that never sinks and is left as authored; eat lets the mandibles dip (sinkAllowed).
